variants.headline: Household savings committed to a company plan
variants.sub: Household savings have been put into a business plan by {founder}.
variants.body:
The settler {founder} has put household savings into a plan for {business} in {district}. The commitment is a plan to start a company, not an announcement that it has opened. For {target}, the relevant question concerns the conditions under which a household commits its means to an undertaking.

A plan backed by savings is a commitment, not an operating business. Managers should distinguish the resources put at risk from a forecast of eventual returns. Commercial respect for initiative is compatible with a careful account of the stages still separating a proposal from a company doing business.

We support {target} in this assessment. A household's commitment to an undertaking deserves a fair hearing, and a plan should not be dismissed simply because its future has not yet become an established result. Reliable assessment begins with particulars rather than a politically convenient assumption.

variants.body:
